# AirDraw Pro

> Next-Generation Contactless AI Spatial Drawing Application powered by Google MediaPipe Hands, client-side WebAssembly, sub-pixel 1-Euro adaptive jitter stabilization, and tactile sound synthesis.

## Quick Facts
- **Application Type**: Touchless In-Air Drawing Web Application (PWA)
- **Official URL**: https://nikithpadmanabhuni.github.io/air-draw/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/nikithpadmanabhuni/air-draw
- **Author**: Nikith Padmanabhuni
- **License**: MIT
- **Inference Engine**: Google MediaPipe Hands (21 3D landmarks, WebAssembly)
- **Target Performance**: 60 FPS rendering, <16ms end-to-end latency
- **Platform Support**: Cross-platform Web, iOS Safari (iPhone & iPad), Android Chrome, macOS, Windows, Linux

## Core Invariant
- **Single-Finger Air Drawing**: Drawing occurs exclusively when the Index Fingertip (☝️) is raised in the air. The cursor follows landmark index 8 stabilized by a dual-pole One-Euro adaptive filter.

## Gesture Command Mapping
- ☝️ **Index Point**: Precision drawing on canvas or air-aiming cursor.
- ✌️ **Peace Sign (V)**: Navigate / hover cursor without drawing (pen up).
- 🤏 **Pinch (Thumb + Index)**: Air-tap click or drag floating windows.
- 🖐️ **Open Palm**: Spatial circular eraser (erases strokes within bounding radius).
- ✊ **Fist**: Pause / rest hand without triggering unintended strokes.
- 3️⃣ **Three Fingers Up**: Instant Undo (reverts last stroke).
- 4️⃣ **Four Fingers Up**: Instant Redo (restores reverted stroke).
- 🤟 **Rock Gesture**: Clear entire canvas.
- 👍 **Thumbs Up**: Quick-save drawing to local browser memory.

## Privacy & Security
- 100% On-Device Client Inference.
- Video stream from the webcam/phone camera never leaves the user's browser.
- Zero server-side video streaming or telemetry.
